node.title: Re^2: printing element of anonymous array
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Just for TIMTOWTDI, [doc://Time::gmtime] has been in core ~10 years longer:

use Time::gmtime; print gmtime->wday;

But there is a difference: [doc://Time::Piece]'s wday index is 1-based (1=Sunday) while [doc://gmtime] and [doc://Time::gmtime]'s wday is 0-based (0=Sunday).
